title: Giving few-shot examples to pin down output structure and style

videos.script: A prompt that works once is a demonstration. A prompt that works on the fortieth message, and the four hundredth, is a product. This course is about the distance between the two. {{title}} You will spend it with one prompt. It sorts the messages a small online bookshop receives, and answers in JSON: a category, an urgency and a one-line summary. {{triage}} The first thing you do is count. Forty messages, five checks, and a number at the bottom. {{check}} The bare prompt passes none of them. Asking for JSON gets twenty-four. Showing three examples of the answer gets thirty-six, and every reply parses. {{counts}} Then you break it on purpose. One extra field in one example, and the model copies it into all forty answers. {{leak}} By the end of the lesson you can tell what an example fixes, what it teaches by accident, and how to tell the two apart with a number. {{close}}
